panel.title: RoomMind
panel.no_areas: No areas configured in Home Assistant.
panel.no_areas_hint: Add areas under Settings › Areas in Home Assistant.
badge.beta_hint: New and still being worked on, may change in the next updates.
room.control_mode.full_control_info: A room sensor measures the temperature. RoomMind decides from it when to heat or cool and sets the devices accordingly. Along the way it learns how fast the room warms up and cools down again, and plans ahead with that.
room.control_mode.managed_info: RoomMind gives the devices the target temperature (from schedule, temporary temperature or vacation), they regulate with their own sensor. The model learns along, but nothing is controlled by it. With a temperature sensor under Sensors, RoomMind controls the room itself.
room.outdoor_hint: Measure only: no control, no mold protection, no learning.
override.invalid_band: Cooling target must be at or above the heating target
override.error_clear: Failed to end the temporary temperature
hero.mpc_learning_paused.outdoor_unavail: To learn, RoomMind needs an outdoor temperature. The outdoor sensor reports nothing right now and no weather forecast is set. Set up one of them under Settings › Sensors & data sources.
hero.compressor_protection_info: This room shares an outdoor unit with other rooms. So the compressor does not keep switching on and off, it has to run for a minimum time and then stay off for a minimum time. Until then this device does not switch.
hero.coil_dry_info: The AC is drying its evaporator and switches off afterwards. If the room needs cooling, it stops at once.
card.no_climate: No device to heat or cool
mode.auto_desc: Heats or cools, depending on where the room is against its target
mode.auto_desc_heat: Heats when the room is too cold. Cooling needs an AC
mode.auto_desc_cool: Cools when the room is too warm. No device here can heat
mode.heat_only_desc: Heats only. Next to thermostats the AC heats only with "Choose heat source" on
mode.cool_only_desc: Cools with the AC only, thermostats stay off
mode.unsupported: No device in this room can do this. Pick another mode.
schedule.selector_warning: Several schedules but nothing to switch them: only the first one applies.
schedule.preheat_hint: Turn off for rooms that should not warm up beforehand, e.g. a bedroom at night. Heating then starts only shortly before the block.
schedule.follow_device_setpoint_label: Take over changes made on the device
schedule.follow_device_setpoint_hint: Only for devices that report their setpoint to Home Assistant. Leave it off if a device or an automation changes the setpoint by itself (own schedule, frost or window protection).
schedule.help_temps_title: Where does the target come from?
schedule.help_temps: The first rule that applies wins:
schedule.help_temps_1: Temporary temperature: comfort, eco or custom, picked on the room or the dashboard card.
schedule.help_temps_2: Vacation: the vacation temperature from the settings.
schedule.help_temps_3: Nobody home: eco, or devices off, as set under presence.
schedule.help_temps_4: Schedule: inside a block its own temperature, else comfort. Outside all blocks eco, or devices off. Without a schedule comfort.
schedule.help_temps_adjust: On top of that: an empty room (occupancy sensors) keeps the schedule at eco at most, the electricity price can shift the schedule target, and mold protection raises the heat target.
schedule.help_block: In the schedule editor every block can get its own temperature. Schedules from YAML take a temperature in the block's data:
schedule.help_block_note: A block without its own temperature uses comfort.
schedule.help_split: In rooms set to Auto, a block gets separate heating and cooling targets with heat_temperature and cool_temperature:
schedule.help_split_note: If one of them is missing, comfort applies for that side. Both take priority over temperature.
schedule.help_multi: A room can have several schedules. A switch entity picks the one that applies: an input_boolean (off = schedule 1, on = schedule 2) or an input_number (the value is the number). Without one only the first applies.
schedule.comfort_hint: Applies while the schedule is on and its block has no temperature of its own. Without a schedule comfort always applies.
schedule.eco_hint: Applies when the schedule is off, nobody is home or the room is empty, depending on your settings, and when you pick Eco.
schedule.block_temp_rejected: Values outside the valid range {min}–{max} {unit}: {values}. The comfort target applies instead. Typo in the schedule?
devices.no_climate: There is no thermostat or AC in this area.
devices.occupancy_eco: Eco when the room is empty
devices.heating_system_type_info: Radiators and especially underfloor heating keep giving off heat after they stop. RoomMind counts this afterglow and overshoots less. Underfloor heating also runs longer at a time.
devices.underfloor_delay_hint: Underfloor heating reacts slowly. Pause only after the window has been open for at least 5 minutes.
devices.heating_system_type_boost_hint: If the heating system has changed, pick "Re-learn faster" for the room under Settings › Model training.
devices.setback_auto_off: Turn off after an hour without demand
devices.coil_dry_global_off_hint: Evaporator drying is off in the settings, so it does not run for this device. Turn it on there, or set this device to "Always on".
devices.info.intro: What each setting does is under the info icon next to it. How RoomMind drives thermostats and ACs is in the documentation.
covers.auto_control_hint: Off: RoomMind does not move the covers at all, not by schedule and not at night either.
covers.deploy_threshold_hint: Covers go down when the sun is expected to heat the room this far past the target.
covers.min_position_hint: Sun protection never closes the covers further. 0 = fully closed.
covers.override_minutes_hint: How long the automation waits after you move a cover by hand. 0 = no pause.
covers.auto_paused: Automation paused, cover moved by hand
covers.night_close_hint: Closes at sunset and opens at sunrise.
covers.window_hold_hint: While a window or door sensor of this room reports open, RoomMind does not lower the covers and catches up once it is closed. For covers that would hit an open window (inside covers, roof windows). A cover that is already moving is not stopped.
covers.schedule_section_hint: Force position: the schedule sets the position. Allow solar protection: RoomMind shades only while the schedule is on.
covers.schedule_selector_hint: input_boolean: off = schedule 1, on = schedule 2. input_number: the value picks the schedule number.
covers.schedule_selector_warning: Several schedules but nothing to switch them: only the first one applies.
covers.schedule_create_link: Create a schedule in Home Assistant
covers.night_position_hint: How far the covers close at night. 0 % = fully closed. A cover's "Fully closed at" applies here too.
covers.night_close_elevation_hint: Sun elevation at which the covers close and open again. 0° = sunset, -6° = dusk, 5° = still light.
covers.night_close_offset_hint: Shifts the time on top of that. +20 = 20 minutes later, negative = earlier.
covers.outdoor_min_temp_hint: Colder outside, the covers stay open for the sun: its warmth is welcome then.
covers.per_cover_min_position_hint: RoomMind never closes this cover further. For covers that are already fully closed above 0 %.
covers.snap_deploy_hint: Goes straight to the lowest position instead of in steps.
covers.info.selection_body: Covers from this area or entities from other areas. RoomMind tracks their position and can move them automatically.
covers.info.schedule_body: A Home Assistant schedule sets when the covers close, e.g. for privacy in the evening. The position attribute in the block says how far. With "Force position" the schedule comes before sun protection and night closing, with "Allow solar protection" RoomMind shades only while the schedule is on.
covers.info.solar_body: If the sun would heat the room past the target, RoomMind lowers the covers beforehand. The deploy threshold sets how far past. While the room model is still learning, RoomMind uses a cautious default.
covers.info.night_body: Closes the covers at sunset and opens them at sunrise. The night position sets how far, e.g. 10 % = almost closed.
covers.info.override_body: If you move a cover by hand, the automation pauses for the set time.
covers.info.priority_body: Moved by hand > schedule > night closing > sun protection. If none of them applies, the covers stay open.
covers.info.entities_body: RoomMind creates two entities per room: switch.roommind_{area}_cover_auto switches the cover automation, e.g. in automations, and binary_sensor.roommind_{area}_cover_paused is on while the automation is paused after a manual move.
covers.orientation_hint: Set the compass direction each cover faces. RoomMind then shades only while the sun is actually on that side of the building. Without a direction, covers react to sunshine in general and may close from sunrise, even on a north window.
settings.climate_control_hint: Off: RoomMind keeps measuring and learning but sends no commands. The devices stay as they are and keep regulating on their own.
settings.learning_hint: Paused: no new measurements, what was learned stays.
settings.outdoor_cooling_min_hint: If it is colder outside, RoomMind does not cool. A temporary temperature set on the room lifts the limit.
settings.outdoor_heating_max_hint: If it is warmer outside, RoomMind does not heat. A temporary temperature set on the room lifts the limit.
settings.control_mode_hint: Predictive: RoomMind plans with the learned room model. While it is still learning, it simply switches on and off. Simple: always just on and off. The model keeps learning anyway, and the covers then use a simpler sun estimate.
settings.comfort_weight_hint: Comfort keeps the room closer to the target and pre-heats earlier. Efficiency allows more deviation and saves run time.
settings.preheat_lead: Pre-heats up to {time} before a warmer schedule block.
settings.preheat_lead_none: No pre-heating: heats only shortly before a warmer schedule block.
settings.weather_entity_hint: Optional. Gives the outdoor temperature for the next hours and steps in when the outdoor sensor fails.
settings.outdoor_unavailable_notify: Notify when outdoor temperature is unavailable
settings.outdoor_unavailable_notify_hint: A notification in Home Assistant when no outdoor temperature arrives for 30 minutes, neither from the sensor nor from the weather forecast. Learning already pauses as soon as it is missing.
settings.prediction_enabled_hint: Shows in the analytics chart how the temperature is likely to go on. Turn it off if the page loads slowly.
vacation.title: Vacation mode
vacation.hint: Ends by itself on the end date, without one only when you switch it off.
analytics.afterglow_sub: In this room it fades in about {time}.
analytics.afterglow_unmeasured: Not measured yet: RoomMind measures it after the next heating runs.
analytics.info.accuracy_idle: How far the model may be off when it predicts the room temperature 5 minutes ahead while nothing heats or cools. It is the model's own estimate, not a measurement, and once the model has learned it settles at about ±{typical} in most homes. It says nothing about how closely the room is kept at its target, that is what "This period" above shows. Below ±{threshold} RoomMind uses its predictive control.
analytics.info.accuracy_heating: The same while heating. It stays higher at first because the model needs real heating runs to learn from. Once heating and idle are below ±{threshold}, RoomMind switches from simple on/off control to predictive control. Overshoot after heating comes from how slowly the heating reacts, not from this value.
analytics.info.confidence: How well the model knows the room: enough readings while idle and while heating or cooling, and how accurately it predicts. Around 50 % it usually still lacks heating or cooling runs. Predictive control starts once enough runs are measured and the prediction is within ±{threshold}, which can be below 80 %.
analytics.comfort_pending: Time on target appears once RoomMind has recorded targets for this room.
analytics.rhythm_hint: Click a date or a cell to show that day above, point at a cell to see the hour.
analytics.rhythm_hint_touch: Tap a date to show that day above, a cell to see the hour.
analytics.info.summary: On target means the room was at most {tolerance} below its heating target or above its cooling target. A room that only heats can only be too cold, one that only cools only too warm. Times with an open window do not count. Runs come from one reading every 3 to 5 minutes, so very short runs can be missing. After a heating run the room often keeps warming for a while: "then avg." is how far it went past the target the run heated for within the hour after it. A pre-heat run counts against the coming target (cooling likewise below the target).
analytics.info.heat_loss: How fast the room cools down without heating at the difference to outside shown above (twice that difference means twice as fast). The lower, the better insulated. To judge a renovation, compare the value before and after. Learned from the room's own behavior; per hour rather than in watts because the model does not know the size of the room.
analytics.info.time_constant: In this time the room, without heating, covers almost two thirds of the way to the outdoor temperature. Longer means better insulated.
analytics.info.heating_rate: How fast the heating warms the room at full power, in degrees per hour. RoomMind uses it to work out when to start heating.
analytics.info.cooling_rate: How fast the AC cools the whole room, walls and furniture included, at full power. The model handles separately that the air at the sensor drops faster at first and springs back after the stop.
analytics.info.afterglow: How much warmer a 10-minute heating run still makes the room after it stops, because the radiators have stored heat, and how long that takes to fade. RoomMind measures this after every run and stops heating earlier to match. If it is large, the room heats in shorter steps so it does not overshoot.
analytics.info.solar_gain: How fast the sun warms the room on a clear summer noon. What arrives right now and at most today is shown below; in winter it is often a quarter. RoomMind heats less when sun is coming. The tile appears once the model has seen sun.
analytics.info.occupancy_gain: How much warmer the room gets per hour while a sensor reports it occupied (people, devices). Learned from the occupied times; until then a dash shows here.
analytics.info.data_points: Readings the model has learned from. About one is added every 3 minutes.
settings.intro.orphans: Rooms whose Home Assistant area was deleted. RoomMind no longer controls them but keeps their settings and what they learned.
settings.orphans_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}" with its settings and learned data?
settings.reset_all_hint: Deletes the model and history of every room.
settings.reset_all_confirm: Delete the model and history of every room? All rooms then learn from scratch.
settings.reset_room_hint: Deletes the model and history of one room.
settings.reset_room_confirm: Delete this room's model and history? It then learns from scratch.
settings.reset_room_confirm_history: Delete the history of this outdoor area?
settings.reset_room_confirm_no_model: Delete this room's history? Without a temperature sensor or device it learns no model.
settings.boost_hint: After a change to the room (new radiator, AC, insulation), pick the graduation cap icon next to the room. New measurements then count more, and the model usually takes on the change with the next heating or cooling runs instead of after about a day. Start from scratch:
settings.boost_confirm: New measurements count more until the next heating or cooling runs are measured. This cannot be undone.
learning.boost_info: After "Re-learn faster" new measurements count more for a while, so the model picks up a change in the room sooner. It fades by itself. The time left is an estimate, it only runs while the room learns (window closed, outdoor temperature known).
analytics.chart_info_body:
**Lines:** The solid line is the measured room temperature, the green dashed line the target in force. Where something other than the schedule set it, it changes color: pink for a temporary temperature, gray-blue when nobody was home, on vacation or the room was empty, brown for mold protection; the tooltip names the reason. Right of the now line: target and prediction (dotted) for the next 3 hours, using the weather forecast if one is set up.

**Target range:** The figures above count the pale green band as on target: from {tolerance} below the heating target up to {tolerance} above the cooling target (heat only: everything from the heating side up, cool only: everything from the cooling side down). Below it is tinted pale blue (too cold), above it pale red (too warm).

**Strip and areas:** The strip along the bottom shows when the room heated (orange) or cooled (blue), a gray area an open window.

**Below:** Outdoor temperature; humidity with a green band for 40–60 % (line yellow at 30–40 and 60–70 %, red beyond; too dry irritates the airways, too humid favors mold on cold walls); electricity price in the source's unit when the room follows the price: green cheap, gray normal, red expensive.
presence.title: Presence
presence.hint_detail: In each room you can pick which persons count there.
presence.room_help_body: The room goes to eco or switches its devices off, depending on the setting, when none of the chosen people is home. Without a choice everyone counts.
presence.room_none_assigned: Everyone counts: eco when nobody is home
presence.room_none_assigned_off: Everyone counts: devices off when nobody is home
presence.missing_entity_hint: This entity no longer exists in Home Assistant. Remove it to clear it from this room.
presence.help_ignore_body: The room always follows its schedule, even when nobody is home. For example a guest room or a room with pets.
presence.tile_ignored: Never switches to eco because nobody is home
presence.clears_override_hint: When nobody is home, a temporary temperature pauses and the room follows the away rule. When someone comes back, it applies again until it runs out.
presence.room_disabled: Presence is off in the settings. What you set here only takes effect once it is on there.
presence.room_no_persons: No person is set up in the settings yet. Until then no room goes to eco or off because nobody is home.
presence.ignore_info: The room never goes to eco or off because nobody is home. For example a guest room or a room that should always stay warm.
presence.persons_info: When none of these people is home, the away rule applies to the room (eco or off). Without a choice everyone from the settings counts.
valve_protection.title: Valve protection
valve_protection.hint: Applies to every thermostat unless a device is excluded.
valve_protection.interval_hint: How many days a valve may stand still before RoomMind moves it briefly (1–90).
compressor.title: Compressor protection
compressor.members_hint: All devices on this outdoor unit or boiler: indoor units, thermostats, fan coils.
compressor.draft_no_members: Saved once it has an indoor unit.
compressor.min_run_hint: The compressor runs at least this long after it starts.
compressor.min_off_hint: The compressor stays off at least this long after it stops.
compressor.master_entity_hint: The device that supplies the group, e.g. a gas boiler, the outdoor unit of a heat pump or the main switch of a ducted system. RoomMind switches it on as soon as a room wants to heat or cool, and off when all rooms are idle. Leave empty if you only need the script or the short-cycle protection.
compressor.conflict_resolution_hint: What applies when one room wants to heat and another wants to cool at the same time. Heating first is the safe choice against frost. Majority: a tie heats. By outdoor temperature: above "No heating above" from the settings it cools, below it heats.
compressor.action_script_hint: A script that runs on every change between heating, cooling and idle, with or without a main device. For example to cancel a Vaillant Quick Veto or switch a relay. It gets the variables action (heat/cool/idle), master_entity, members and active_members.
compressor.enforce_uniform_mode_hint: All devices in the group heat, or all cool. A room that wants the opposite waits meanwhile. For heat pumps that start by themselves but need all indoor units in the same mode.
coil_dry.title: Evaporator drying
coil_dry.hint: Applies to every AC unless set otherwise on the device.
coil_dry.duration_hint: How long the fan keeps running (1–60 min). At a low fan speed about twice as long as at a high one.
coil_dry.min_cooling_hint: Only dry once the AC has cooled this long. Short cooling runs are added up (1–240 min).
coil_dry.mode_dry_warning: When dehumidifying the compressor keeps running and cools the fins down again, which works against drying. Only pick this if your device's dry mode mainly runs the fan.
coil_dry.fan_mode_hint: Higher dries faster but is louder. If the device does not know the speed, it keeps its current one.
coil_dry.drain_hint: The AC stays off first so the condensate can drain, then the fan starts (0–15 min). Less moisture is blown back into the room.
mold.title: Mold protection
mold.detection_desc: Shows the mold risk in the room and reports it (recipients under Notifications).
mold.threshold_hint: Warns when the room humidity stays above this. Apart from that, RoomMind warns when the coldest spot of the wall gets too damp.
mold.insulation_hint: Used to estimate how cold the coldest spot of your exterior walls gets (corners, window reveals). Well insulated means new or renovated. If unsure, keep Standard. Needs an outdoor temperature.
mold.sustained_hint: How long the risk has to last before RoomMind warns.
mold.prevention_desc: Raises the heating target while there is a mold risk. Only in rooms that can heat.
mold.intensity_hint: Warmer air makes cold spots on the wall drier. The stronger, the more heating energy. Light is usually enough.
settings.intro.sensors: Outdoor temperature, outdoor humidity and weather forecast.
settings.intro.control: How RoomMind controls, and when it does not heat or cool because of the outdoor temperature.
settings.intro.presence: When nobody is home, rooms go to eco or off.
settings.intro.vacation: Lowers all rooms to one fixed temperature while you are away.
settings.intro.valve: Moves thermostat valves that have not moved for a long time, so they do not get stuck.
settings.intro.compressor: For indoor units on a shared outdoor unit or boiler: a minimum run and off time prevent constant on and off.
settings.intro.mold: Warns of mold risk and can heat against it.
settings.intro.notifications: Who gets a message when there is a mold risk.
settings.intro.learning: How far each room's model is, pause learning and re-learn faster after changes.
settings.intro.reset: Deletes what was learned and the history. The room learns from scratch.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.enabled_hint: Off: no mold messages, neither to the phone nor to the sidebar.
notifications.desc: Without recipients the message appears in the Home Assistant sidebar.
notifications.add_target_hint: If your phone is not in the list, type its service by hand, e.g. notify.mobile_app_your_phone.
notifications.mold_off: Mold detection is off, so RoomMind reports nothing.
notifications.mold_off_prevention: Mold detection is off. Messages only come when RoomMind heats to prevent mold.
notifications.mold_prevention_notify: Report when RoomMind heats to prevent mold
notifications.mold_prevention_notify_hin: A message as soon as the heating target is raised against mold.
heat_source.toggle_hint: RoomMind heats either with the radiators or with the AC, depending on the outdoor temperature. Far below the target both heat.
heat_source.primary_delta_hint: Without an outdoor temperature, the radiators heat from this gap on, below it the AC. From twice this gap plus 0.3 K both heat, until the gap drops below this value again.
heat_source.outdoor_threshold_hint: Warmer outside, the AC heats; colder, the radiators.
heat_source.ac_min_outdoor_hint: Below this outdoor temperature only the radiators heat, to protect the device.
heat_source.summary_disabled: Off: radiators and AC heat together
heat_source.rule_gap: Radiators from {delta} below target, else AC
heat_source.both_from: Both heat from {delta} below the target
heat_source.help_body: Only in rooms with a room sensor, a thermostat and an AC, and only while heating. With an outdoor temperature it alone decides: above the switch point the AC heats, below it the radiators. Without one, the radiators heat from the set gap to the target, the AC below it. From twice the gap plus 0.3 K both heat until the gap drops below the set value. Below the minimum outdoor temperature the AC never heats. With the price option, expensive power means radiators and cheap power the AC; at a normal price the rules above apply.
devices.type_info: Thermostat for radiator valves and underfloor heating, AC for anything that cools or heats with air. This decides how RoomMind drives the device.
devices.managed_note: Without a room sensor every device regulates with its own sensor. Setpoint mode and valve control need a temperature sensor in the room.
devices.setpoint_mode_info: Proportional: RoomMind moves the device's setpoint and so controls how hard it heats or cools. Direct: the device gets the room's target temperature and regulates on its own.
devices.setpoint_offset_info: Added to the room target before it goes to the device. If the device reads 2 degrees colder than your room sensor, enter -2.
devices.idle_info_trv: What the thermostat gets when the room needs no heat. "Low setpoint" keeps it at its minimum instead of off, for wireless thermostats that fall asleep when off and then miss commands.
devices.idle_info_ac: "Turn off" switches the device off. "Fan only" keeps the fan running. "Setback" leaves it on and moves the setpoint {delta} away from the room target, e.g. for multi-split systems.
devices.idle_fan_mode_info: Fan speed while the idle device only runs its fan.
devices.setback_auto_off_info: Switches the device off when it had nothing to do for an hour and RoomMind does not need it in the next hour either. Only works once the room model has learned and controls predictively.
devices.valve_direct_info: RoomMind sets the valve opening itself, e.g. to 30 %, instead of opening the valve fully. That is quieter and more even. Off: the thermostat controls the valve again.
devices.valve_opening_info: The number entity Home Assistant uses to set the valve opening, e.g. valve_opening_degree. Leave it empty to hand the valve back to the thermostat.
devices.valve_closing_info: The number entity for the closing degree, e.g. valve_closing_degree. It holds the valve at the set opening, whatever the thermostat wants. Filled in when it is named like the opening.
devices.valve_idle_opening_info: The valve opening while the thermostat is not heating, e.g. idle_valve_position in Zigbee2MQTT.
devices.valve_closing_mode_info: Most thermostats have a closing degree, e.g. the SONOFF TRVZB. The SONOFF TRV-ZBT has an idle opening instead. Pick the wrong one and its valve stays open when the room needs no heat.
devices.valve_protection_exclude_info: Valve protection then leaves this valve alone. Useful for entities without a real valve, e.g. a virtual boiler.
devices.coil_dry_info: After cooling the fan keeps running for a while without cooling, so the evaporator dries and does not smell musty. "As global" follows Settings › Evaporator drying.
devices.coil_dry_minutes_info: How long the device runs its fan after cooling.
devices.coil_dry_mode_info: "Fan only" almost always fits. Pick "Dehumidify" only if the device's dry mode mainly runs the fan, else the compressor cools the fins down again.
devices.coil_dry_fan_mode_info: Fan speed while drying. "Keep current speed" leaves the fan as it is.
devices.heating_system_type_scope: Applies to all thermostats in this room.
roomcard.name: RoomMind room
roomcard.description: Room status, quick choice for a temporary temperature, mode and comfort/eco values.
roomcard.no_area: Choose a room in the card settings.
roomcard.unknown_room: This room has no devices set up in RoomMind.
roomcard.editor.hide_override: Hide “Change the temperature for a while”
roomcard.editor.hide_mode: Hide mode (auto, heat only, cool only)
analytics.zoom_hint: Drag across the chart to zoom, Ctrl + scroll to zoom in steps, Shift + scroll to move.
analytics.zoom_hint_touch: Pinch to zoom, then move with one finger.
analytics.overshoot_heat: then avg. {value} over target, at most {max}
analytics.overshoot_cool: then avg. {value} under target, at most {max}
settings.intro.price: Rooms heat and cool a little more while electricity is cheap and a little less while it is expensive.
settings.price_entity_hint: A price sensor (Tibber, Nordpool, EPEX Spot, aWATTar, ENTSO-e, Octopus, template) or a switch that is on while power is cheap (PV surplus, off-peak tariff). If the sensor has a forecast (raw_today/raw_tomorrow, data, prices, …), RoomMind heats ahead of expensive hours, otherwise it compares the price with the last days. The unit does not matter.
settings.price_unreadable: The price source has no usable value right now. Rooms keep their schedule until it does.
settings.price_kind_history: no forecast, ranked against the last {hours} h
settings.price_kind_history_learning: no forecast, collecting prices ({hours} of {needed} h)
schedule.price_shift_hint: When electricity is cheap the target may rise a little, when it is expensive it may drop a little (cooling the other way round). This only helps if the room heats or cools with electricity (heat pump, AC, electric heater); with a gas or oil boiler it does nothing.
heat_source.price_aware_hint: Only useful when the radiators run on gas, oil or district heat: expensive power, the radiators heat; cheap power, the AC. On a cold day (below “AC above outdoor”) the AC then only takes gaps smaller than “Gap to target”; a larger one, such as heating up for the next comfort period, stays with the radiators. At a normal price the outdoor rule still decides. Far below the target both heat.
analytics.price_shifted: Target moved by the price for {value}
hero.price_charging: Electricity cheap: target {value} to store heat
hero.setback_info: The room needs no heating or cooling right now. Devices with the idle action "Setback" stay on in their mode with a lowered setpoint, so they can pick up again quickly. With "Turn off after an hour without demand" they switch off once the hour is over and RoomMind does not need them in the next hour either.
card.control_off_global: Climate control is off for all rooms
card.control_off_room: Climate control is off for this room
card.no_climate_hint: Assign a thermostat or AC to this area in Home Assistant
panel.edit.intro_wide: Drag a card by the bar at its top, or select the bar and move it with the arrow keys. The eye hides a room.
panel.edit.intro_narrow: Drag a room by its handle or move it through the menu. The eye hides a room.

sensors.temp_info: With a sensor RoomMind measures the room itself and tells the devices when to heat or cool (Full Control). Without one the devices regulate with their own sensor (Managed).
sensors.full_control_note: Full Control: RoomMind regulates by this sensor. Without it the devices regulate on their own again.
sensors.device_sensor_note: RoomMind controls by the device's own sensor. It sits next to the radiator or at the air inlet and often reads warmer or colder than the room. A separate room sensor controls more precisely.
sensors.outdoor_note: Only measured and shown, nothing is controlled.
sensors.humidity_info: Shows the humidity and is needed for the mold warning. Without a sensor the room gets no mold warning.
sensors.window_info: While a window or door is open, RoomMind pauses heating and cooling in this room.
sensors.window_open_delay_info: How long a window has to be open before RoomMind pauses. A short opening then interrupts nothing.
sensors.window_close_delay_info: How long RoomMind waits after closing before it heats or cools again.
sensors.occupancy_info: Motion or presence sensors in the room. RoomMind uses them to learn how much heat people add and can switch an empty room to eco.
sensors.occupancy_eco_info: When all sensors report the room empty for longer than the delay, eco applies until someone is back. The room then only warms up once someone is in it. A temporary temperature, vacation and presence come first.
sensors.occupancy_eco_delay_info: How long all sensors have to report nothing before eco applies (5 to 240 minutes).
sensors.help: RoomMind suggests the sensors of the room's area. The search under each group also takes a sensor from another area. What a sensor does is explained at the group's info icon.

settings.summary.notify_no_source: On, but mold detection is off
sensors.co2_info: A CO₂ sensor (ppm) tells when the air is stale. RoomMind then shows a hint, switches a binary sensor for your own automations and can switch a ventilation unit on.
sensors.voc_info: A VOC sensor reacts to cooking, cleaning agents and off-gassing. It works like the CO₂ sensor once you set a threshold in the sensor's unit.
sensors.ventilation_info: A fan, switch or input_boolean that ventilates the room, e.g. an extractor fan or the boost of a ventilation system with heat recovery. Recirculating air (an AC's fan mode) does not lower the CO₂.
sensors.ventilation_note: RoomMind switches it on when the air turns bad and off again once it is good, after at least 15 minutes. It only switches off what it switched on itself. With climate control off it switches nothing on, and one it runs goes off.
sensors.no_ventilation: None. Without one, RoomMind only shows the air quality.
sensors.co2_threshold_info: From this value on the air counts as stale, good again below 80 % of it (below 800 ppm at 1000). The German Environment Agency rates below 1000 ppm as harmless and asks for more fresh air from 1000 ppm on.
sensors.voc_threshold_info: In the sensor's unit. VOC sensors report an index, ppb or µg/m³, so there is no default. For a µg/m³ sensor the German Environment Agency rates TVOC above 1000 µg/m³ as conspicuous; index sensors (100 = the room's daily average) often use 250. Good again below 80 % of the threshold. Empty the field to only show the value.
sensors.voc_not_judged: No threshold: the value is only shown.
card.hint.air_bad: Poor air quality, air the room
